value.rationale: The co-singleton spectrum is the canonical densest proper character set, so its exact Lambda(4) norm is a natural boundary benchmark rather than an arbitrary slice. The theorem is uniform over every finite abelian group of a given order and gives all extremizers, revealing a group-independent point-mass-defect structure useful for comparison with thin-set and sparse-spectrum regimes.
